maddeler.e:
استقين (form VIII)
# اِسْتَقَيْنَ (istaqayna) /is.ta.qaj.na/: third-person feminine plural past active of اِسْتَقَى (istaqā)
# اُسْتُقِينَ (ustuqīna) /us.tu.qiː.na/: third-person feminine plural past passive of اِسْتَقَى (istaqā)
# اِسْتَقِينَ (istaqīna) /is.ta.qiː.na/: second-person feminine plural imperative of اِسْتَقَى (istaqā)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
